name: Otozawa Mie
source:
Kenji's mother, who runs a diner with her own hands and has a bold and spirited personality.

After her husband's death, she has not remarried, but instead satisfies her desire to have sex with her son.

From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mamatuma.htmll]official site[/url].
